title: 第十三章　乌托邦的悖谬逻辑

children: 我的开端里就有我的终结。
In my beginning is my end.
主要问题不是极权主义模式是否适用于斯大林的俄罗斯……问题在于社会主义。对一些人来说，把斯大林主义恐怖的受害者与社会主义联系起来是迫切的道德要求；对另一些人来说，同样紧迫的是把恐怖与社会主义事业分开，表明那是一种背离……[并从而]维护苏联社会主义的荣誉……

What is primarily at issue is not the applicability of the totalitarian model to Stalin’s Russia…. What is at issue is socialism. For some, it is a matter of moral urgency to link the victims of Stalinist terror to socialism; for others, it is no less urgent to detach the terror from the socialist cause and show it to be an aberration … [and thereby to] uphold the honor of Soviet socialism….
——《俄罗斯评论》，1986年一篇关于斯大林主义辩论的导言
—Russian Review, introducing a debate on Stalinism in 1986

zh: 在苏联社会主义实验七十四年留下的瓦砾中，我们解释现代最伟大乌托邦冒险的经典范畴变成了什么？从其前所未有的消亡方式中是否产生了任何新问题？这场崩溃对未来意味着什么——首先对俄罗斯和其他前共产主义国家意味着什么，对社会主义本身又意味着什么？把最后两个问题留给推测性的尾声，我们先从对过去的解释开始。
en: Amidst the rubble left over from seventy-four years of the Soviet socialist experiment, what has become of our classical categories for explaining that greatest of all utopian adventures of the modern age? Have any new questions emerged from the unprecedented manner of its demise? And what does the collapse portend for the future, above all of Russia and the other former Communist countries, but also of socialism as such? Leaving these last two questions for a speculative epilogue, we will begin with interpretations of the past.

zh: 脆弱性的根源
en: THE ROOTS OF FRAGILITY

zh: 确实出现了一些新问题，但仔细考察，大多数都回到围绕苏联制度可改革性的旧争论。当然，这些新问题不再主要围绕十月革命的合法性、新经济政策替代方案、斯大林的“必要性”来提出。相反，它们——尽管现在用的是过去时——聚焦于改革时期争论的重大问题：戈尔巴乔夫的改革能否成功？但这当然只是赫鲁晓夫以来关于苏维埃主义隐含中心问题的另一种表述：列宁主义制度能否转变为社会民主制和/或半市场化社会主义？
en: A few new questions have indeed emerged, but on closer examination most lead back to the old debates around the reformability of the Soviet system. These new questions, of course, no longer raise that issue primarily in terms of the legitimacy of October, the NEP alternative, the “necessity” of Stalin. Instead they focus, though now in the past tense, on the great question debated during

itself: could Gorbachev’s reforms have succeeded? But this, of course, is just another formulation of the implicit central question about Sovietism since Khrushchev: can a Leninist system transform itself into a social democracy and/or a semimarket socialism?

zh: 人们可能以为，1989—1991年的大崩溃会一劳永逸地解决这些问题，结论是共产主义不可改革，因为它事实上未能改革自身。但不：有人提出反对，说某事没有发生，并不意味着它永远不可能发生。从抽象逻辑上说，这是对的。但我们面对的不是抽象逻辑。我们面对的是具体历史事件，而1989—1991年共产主义崩溃的连锁反应无疑应该告诉我们一些有关这一特定制度逻辑的事情。
en: One might think that the great crash of 1989-1991 would have settled these questions once and for all with the conclusion that Communism was irreformable, since it in fact failed to reform itself. But no: the objection is raised that because something did not happen, this does not mean it could never have happened. And as a matter of abstract logic, this is true. But we are not dealing with abstract logic. We are dealing with concrete historical events, and the cascade of Communist collapses in 1989-1991 ought surely to tell us something about the logic of that particular system.

zh: 然而这一事实迟迟未被接受。于是我们再次听到苏联历史中各种有希望的替代方案，并嗅到对新经济政策以来所有未走道路的甜蜜怀旧气息。这种怀旧以新面目出现，声称苏联崩溃是由政权最后几年的偶然事件和错误造成的，因而本可避免。
另一种说法是，1991年苏联崩溃不是叶利钦和民主派所称的革命断裂，而是“向民主和市场的过渡”，因而是改革共产主义和戈尔巴乔夫改革的“进化式”完成。的确，八月之后，这就是戈尔巴乔夫本人的立场。当然，这一切再次提出了实验展开中的预定论与自由问题。
en: Yet this fact has been slow to sink in. We thus hear once again of promising alternatives in Soviet history, and breathe the sweet scent of nostalgia for all the roads not taken, from the NEP onward. In its new guise, this nostalgia takes the form that the Soviet collapse was produced by accidents and errors of the last years of the regime, and hence that it represented a contingency that might have been averted.

Another way of putting this proposition is that the Soviet collapse of 1991 was not a revolutionary break, as Yeltsin and the democrats claim, but a “transition to democracy and the market,” and thus the “evolutionary” fulfillment of Reform Communism and
. Indeed, after August this was the position of Gorbachev himself. And all of this, of course, raises again the issue of predetermination versus freedom in the unfolding of the experiment.

zh: 这种进化视角确实有几分道理——但只有当我们局限于崩溃的直接原因时。这些原因已在前两章详细考察。扼要重述：最根本的原因是经济衰退及其对苏联超级大国地位的影响。正是这种绩效危机促使戈尔巴乔夫首先发动改革；而这种改组很快导致他攻击党，从而承担了公开性、然后是民主化那种结果证明是自杀性的风险。最后，经济衰退使意识形态的主张失去信誉，而公开性使人们可以宣告这一事实，从而使制度失去合法性，并最终剥夺其强制意志。这一情况反过来使少数民族的反叛和人民民主国家的崩溃成为可能。最后，我们还可以把戈尔巴乔夫的各种战术错误纳入因果链，例如民主化推进得比经济自由化快，或在最后让自己被反对其改革的保守派包围。
en: There is indeed something to this evolutionary perspective—but only if we restrict ourselves to the proximate causes of the collapse. And these causes have been examined in detail in the preceding two chapters. To recapitulate: The most fundamental cause was the economic decline and its repercussions for the Soviet Union’s superpower status. It is this crisis of performance that moved Gorbachev to launch
in the first place; and this restructuring soon led him to attack the Party, and so run what turned out to be the suicidal risks of
and then of democratization. Finally, the economic decline discredited the claims of the ideology, and

made it possible to proclaim this fact, thereby delegitimizing the system and, ultimately, depriving it of the will to coerce. And this circumstance in turn made possible the revolt of the minority nationalities and the collapse of the people’s democracies. Finally, we may include in the chain of causation various tactical errors of Gorbachev, such as pushing democratization faster than economic liberalization, or, at the end, surrounding himself with conservative enemies of his own reforms.

zh: 但用这些直接原因、连同通常嵌入其中的进化视角来解释苏联崩溃，如同许多旧苏联学一样，既是一种分析模式，也是一种政治表态。如前所述，这种方法是改革所激起的期望的延续——确实是阿马尔里克所谓“改革主义意识形态”的最后喘息，而且在本应受到改革的制度消亡后仍然延续。或者，也许还不完全是最后喘息，因为渐进演变的论证在紧接着的后共产主义时期又回来了，谴责叶利钦向市场的休克疗法转变，并敦促尽可能保留苏联社会主义的“成就”：国家所有制、残余计划的强有力“产业政策”和广泛的社会安全网；有时这种共同体团结也被说成是真正的俄罗斯传统，颇像旧制度时期的民粹派所主张的。
en: But explanation of the Soviet collapse by these proximate causes, together with the evolutionary perspective in which they are usually inserted, is, like so much of the old Sovietology, both a mode of analysis and a political statement. As already noted, this approach is a continuation of the expectations aroused by

—indeed the last gasp of what Amalrik called the “ideology of reformism,” prolonged beyond the life of what was supposed to have been reformed. Or perhaps it is not quite the last gasp, for the evolutionary argument returned in the immediate post-Communist period to condemn Yeltsin’s shock-therapy conversion to the market and urge retention of as much as possible of the “accomplishments” of Soviet socialism: state ownership, a strong “industrial policy” of residual planning, and a broad social safety net; and at times such communal solidarity was also represented as the authentic Russian tradition, somewhat as old-regime Populists had argued.

zh: 在后苏联语境中，改革共产主义的幽灵归来时通常带着令人安心的名字“中间主义”和“渐进主义”，意思是在声名扫地的共产主义与输入的无管制资本主义意识形态之间走一条合理的中间道路。简言之，我们得到了著名的“第三条道路”的后共产主义版本；这条道路自1930年代以来一直伴随着我们，也与西方对“戈尔比”的崇拜有关。因此毫不奇怪，俄罗斯和西方许多前改革信徒成了“中间主义”的拥护者，昔日的戈尔巴乔夫粉丝作为反叶利钦者卷土重来。
的确，令人惊讶的是，共产主义的垮台对改变关于共产主义意义辩论的基本结构几乎没有什么作用。
en: In the post-Soviet context, this return of the ghost of Reform Communism has usually gone by the reassuring names “centrism” and “gradualism,” by which is meant a reasonable median course between a discredited Communism and an imported ideology of unregulated capitalism. In short, we have been offered a post-Communist version of the famous “third way” that has been with us since the 1930s and that was also associated with the Western cult of “Gorby.” Not surprisingly, therefore, many of the former votaries of
in both Russia and the West have become proponents of “centrism,” and erstwhile Gorbophiles have made a comeback as Yeltsinophobes.
Indeed, it is amazing how little Communism’s fall did to change the basic structure of the debate about Communism’s meaning.

zh: 因此更须强调，共产主义崩溃的直接“原因”不是离散或偶然的现象，不是重新排列它们就能让改革挽救制度。相反，它们是源自该制度本身性质的一种模式的组成部分。于是，1991年后关于改革所谓前途的问题，结果与早先关于共产主义可改革性的问题属于同一类——也就是说，它们是假问题。真正的新问题涉及共产主义在终点时异常脆弱的根源。因为1989—1991年的崩溃确实令人惊叹：的确，共产主义任何方面都不如它退出历史的方式那样令世界震惊。世界两个超级大国之一内爆了，而其守护者没有对这场灾难作任何认真抵抗。现代最具战斗性的政治运动，在其时代曾以武装起义和少数政变起家，最后只表现出1991年8月那场可怜的闹剧。
en: It is therefore all the more necessary to emphasize that the proximate “causes” of Communism’s collapse are not discrete or adventitious phenomena, a rearrangement of which could have permitted
to salvage the system. Rather, they are parts of a pattern arising from the nature of that system itself. Thus, the post-1991 questions about the putative promise of

turn out to be in the same category as earlier questions about the reformability of Communism—that is, they are false questions. The real new questions concern the sources of the extraordinary fragility of Communism at its end. For the collapse of 1989-1991 was truly amazing: Indeed, nothing about Communism ever astounded the world so much as the manner of its exit from history. One of the world’s two superpowers imploded without its guardians offering any serious resistance to the debacle. The most militant political movement of the modern age, which in its time had made a career of armed insurrections and minority coups d’état, at the end proved capable only of the pitiful farce of August 1991.

zh: 这种终末脆弱性的解释，在于苏联制度那些长期“系统性”缺陷，它们一直是前面各章的主题。再次扼要重述：苏联制度最深的起源和正当性来自社会主义作为人类平等完满性的道德观念。这一道德观念必然导致一项工具性纲领，即压制不平等的主要根源：私有财产、利润和市场，这组制度被称为资本主义。这个纲领本应自行从历史逻辑（也是民主逻辑）中产生。然而事实上，历史拒绝合作产生所需的工具性纲领，因此后者不得不通过一种新的、独特的政治工具——党——强制实施。
en: The explanation of this terminal fragility lies in those long-term “systemic” flaws of the Soviet system that have been the subject of all the preceding chapters. So to recapitulate again: The Soviet system had its deepest origins in, and drew its justification from, the moral idea of socialism as the fullness of human equality. This moral idea necessarily leads to an instrumental program for the suppression of the prime sources of inequality: private property, profit, and the market, an ensemble of institutions called capitalism. This program was supposed to emerge by itself from the logic of history (which is also the logic of democracy). In fact, however, history refused to cooperate in producing the requisite instrumental program, and so the latter had to be implemented coercively through a new and unique political instrument: the Party.

zh: 因此，苏维埃主义持久的公式是：最大主义或完整社会主义，作为所谓历史逻辑的顶点，与党的专政相结合，以取代历史所谓钦定的载体——无产阶级这个普遍阶级。这个公式在本书中被概括为“意识形态专政的党治制”。苏联实验的全部内容就是用这种钝器建设社会主义，而不是发展或现代化。但这样的工程本质上不可能，因为党治制的粗陋军事手段按其性质无法实现高效经济与公正平等社会相结合的意识形态目标。在这种情况下，建设苏联社会主义只能作为意识形态幻想和赤裸强制的混合物推进。这意味着整个“实验”从一开始就以悖谬方式展开，即从1917年十月政变第一次布尔什维克强制历史的尝试，以及随后1918年用军事手段建设共产主义的努力开始。这一“原罪”导致了所有后续强制行为，始于1929—1933年自上而下的革命，延续于清洗，最后以战后制度复原告终。
en: Thus, the enduring formula of Sovietism is maximalist or integral socialism as the alleged culmination of the logic of history in conjunction with the dictatorship of the Party substituting for history’s allegedly annointed vehicle, the universal class of the proletariat. This formula has been abbreviated in these pages to “ideocratic partocracy.” It is building socialism with this blunt instrument, not development or modernization, that the Soviet experiment was all about. But such an enterprise is intrinsically impossible, for the primitive military means of the partocracy by their very nature cannot realize the combined ideological ends of an efficient economy and a just, egalitarian society. Under such circumstances, the building of Soviet socialism could proceed only as a mixture of ideological illusion and raw coercion. And this meant that the whole “experiment” unfolded in perverse fashion from its beginnings, that is, from the first Bolshevik attempt to coerce history by the October coup of 1917 and the ensuing effort of 1918 to build Communism by military means. From this “original sin” flowed all of the succeeding acts of coercion, starting with the revolution from above of 1929-1933, continuing with the purges, and culminating with the postwar restoration of the system.

zh: 然而必须强调，这一论证绝不是决定论的。最后再扼要重述一次：本书展开的苏联历史“逻辑”相当于一个“如果—那么”论证。

换言之，一旦一个民族的历史中发生某一事件，某些发展道路就被封闭，只剩下另一个更狭窄的可能性范围。因此，1917年的俄罗斯本可以演变为宪政民主（这一选项包括西方那样的“柔性”社会主义福利国家）、民族威权主义或共产主义独裁。但一旦作出“社会主义选择”（戈尔巴乔夫过去常这么说），就只剩下非常狭窄的选项范围——即不放弃该制度的前提下可能采取的选项。这种限制性情况在本书中被称为共产主义的“遗传密码”。具体而言，这意味着，鉴于布尔什维克的目标是整体社会主义与党的专政相结合，苏联政权只能接受既压制“资本主义”又保持党权力垄断的纲领，否则就会取消著名的“十月作出的民族选择”。
en: It is necessary to emphasize, however, that this argument is in no way a deterministic one. So to recapitulate one final time: The “logic” of Soviet history that has been developed in these pages amounts to an “if-then” argument.

In other words, once a given event in the life of a nation has occurred, certain avenues of development are thereby foreclosed, and only another, narrower range of possibilities remains open. Thus Russia in 1917 could have evolved into a constitutional democracy (an option that includes a “soft” socialist welfare state, as in the West), or a national authoritarianism, or a Communist dictatorship. But once the “socialist choice” (as Gorbachev used to say) was made, only a very narrow range of options remained possible—that is, possible without abandoning the system. This confining circumstance has been called in these pages Communism’s “genetic code.” Specifically, this means that given the Bolsheviks’ goal of integral socialism in conjunction with the dictatorship of the Party, the Soviet regime could accept only those programs that both suppressed “capitalism” and preserved the Party’s monopoly of power, for anything else would have annulled the famous “national choice made in October.”

zh: 在实践中，这条路意味着自上而下的不断革命。但由于这样一种治理方式如果过于无情地推行，也会因摧毁国家而威胁政权，它必须通过周期性退却到某种新经济政策形式来缓和，从而产生“硬”共产主义与“软”共产主义交替的模式。但软共产主义也不能被允许获胜，因为它同样会摧毁政权。因此布哈林和新经济政策从来不是斯大林主义的真正替代方案。一个建立在列宁主义选择之上的制度，真正的选项要么是做斯大林所做的近似之事并坚决捍卫它，要么放弃整个制度；而后一种结果正是戈尔巴乔夫的新布哈林主义在1989—1991年导致的。布哈林和新经济政策从来只代表一种永恒而不可或缺的慰藉性幻想，以为可以实现自相矛盾的民主共产主义，或“具有人性面孔的社会主义”。
en: In practice this course meant permanent revolution from above. But since such a regimen, if pursued too relentlessly, would also have menaced the regime by destroying the country, it had to be tempered by periodic retreats to some form of NEP, thus producing a pattern of alternation between “hard” and “soft” Communism. But soft Communism could not be permitted to triumph either, for it too would have destroyed the regime. Thus Bukharin and the NEP were never the real alternative to Stalinism. The real options for a system founded on the Leninist choice were either doing, and then adamantly defending, approximately what Stalin did, or abandoning the whole system; and this latter outcome is just where Gorbachev’s neo-Bukharinism led in 1989-1991. Bukharin and the NEP were never more than the eternal—and indispensably comforting—illusion of achieving that contradiction in terms: democratic Communism, or “socialism with a human face.”

zh: 然而，自上而下的“永久”革命不能无限维持。斯大林治下最初的经济迅速扩张之后，共产主义的回报逐渐递减。与此同时，工具性纲领的残酷结果日益背离最初的道德灵感。于是，社会主义在1930年代刚建成，其奠基神话就变成了谎言。然后，随着经济缓慢衰退和斯大林之后漫长岁月中政权的道德失败，意识形态的可信性蒸发了；没有意识形态的支撑，党的强制意志也受到侵蚀。到戈尔巴乔夫时代，这种侵蚀使新生的公民社会得以挑战党的霸权。因此，当机关1991年8月不可避免地试图逆转改革时，它可耻地失败了，整个衰朽结构在三天内崩溃。因为“建设社会主义”这一不可能事业的内部矛盾最终充分展开、彻底使制度失去信誉——从而引起制度的突然内爆——始终只是时间问题。如果说共产主义最终像纸牌屋一样倒塌，那是因为它一直就是纸牌屋。
en: Yet a “permanent” revolution from above cannot be sustained indefinitely. After an initial burst of economic expansion under Stalin, Communism therefore yielded progressively diminishing returns. At the same time, the brutal results of the instrumental program increasingly belied the original moral inspiration. Thus, no sooner had socialism been built in the 1930s than the Myth on which it was founded was transformed into the Lie. Then, with creeping economic decline and the moral failure of the regime during the long years after Stalin, the credibility of the ideology evaporated; and without the prop of ideology, the Party’s will to coerce eroded. By the time of Gorbachev, this erosion permitted a nascent civil society to challenge the Party’s hegemony. So when the apparat’s inevitable attempt to roll back reform was made in August 1991, it was defeated ignominiously, and the whole decrepit structure collapsed in three days. For it had always been only a question of time before the internal contradictions of the impossible undertaking of “building socialism” worked themselves out to a total discrediting—and hence to the brusque implosion—of the system. If in the end Communism collapsed like a house of cards, it was because it had always been a house of cards.

zh: 总之，不存在社会主义这种东西，而苏联把它建成了。因此，当灾难性的无竞争力经济表现最终使这一悖论显而易见时，“现实存在的”马克思主义的制度化幻想便化为乌有。苏维埃主义的“超现实”突然停止，俄罗斯从噩梦中醒来，置身于这场已持续七十余年的灾难所留下的瓦砾之中。
世界其余部分也与她一起，从主宰了短暂二十世纪的、对十月革命的病态迷恋中醒来。
en: In sum, there is no such thing as socialism, and the Soviet Union built it. Thus, when a disastrously noncompetitive economic performance at last made this paradox apparent, the institutionalized fantasy of “really existing” Marxism vanished into thin air. The “surreality” of Sovietism suddenly ceased, and Russia awoke as from a bad dream amidst the rubble of a now septagenarian disaster.
And the rest of the world awoke with her from the morbid fascination with October that has dominated our short twentieth century.

zh: 尽管如此，1991年八月革命确实
某种不完整之处。也许并非偶然，“未遂政变”或“政变”这些说法没有立即被更恰当的“八月革命”取代，或者叶利钦的革命性市场化和私有化一直被称作“改革”，仿佛他是第二个戈尔巴乔夫。诚然，1991年的断裂不如1917年或1789年那么尖锐，但现代史上具有板块运动般影响的时刻只有两个。那么，1991年8月在革命里氏震级上处于什么位置？
en: Still, there

something incomplete about the August revolution in 1991. It is perhaps no accident that the terms “failed coup” or “putsch” were not immediately replaced by the more appropriate “August Revolution,” or that Yeltsin’s revolutionary marketization and privatization were persistently referred to as “reform,” as if he were some Gorbachev II. To be sure, 1991 was a less sharp break than 1917 or 1789, but then there are only two such tectonic dates in modern history. So where does August 1991 fall on the revolutionary Richter scale?

zh: 从渐进演变的角度看，可以论证暴力很小，大多数旧演员在洪水之后仍然在位，许多人还在旧职位上，而心态以及部分制度的根本变化发生在1989和1990年，而不是八月之后。就其所及而言，这一切都对。但如果我们再往前走一点，就会看到1991年共产党被摧毁，一个超级大国被肢解；“社会主义”被世界第一个社会主义社会放弃，转而“恢复资本主义”；20世纪最持久的幻想，即马克思列宁主义的伪宗教兼伪科学，干脆蒸发了。而这些事情中没有一件能够不经过八月冲击、仅以渐进的方式发生：旧秩序力量与新秩序力量之间的一场力量考验，对于实现“过渡”是绝对必要的。
en: One can argue, on the side of evolution, that violence was minimal, that most of the old actors were still there after the deluge, many of them in their old jobs, and that the essential changes in mentalities and, partially, in institutions had occurred in 1989 and 1990, not in the wake of August. All true, as far as it goes. But if we go a bit farther, we see that in 1991 the Communist Party was destroyed and a superpower was dismembered; “socialism” was renounced by the world’s first socialist society in favor of the “restoration of capitalism”; and the most enduring fantasy of the twentieth century, the pseudoreligion-cum-pseudoscience of Marxism-Leninism, simply evaporated. Nor could any of these things have occurred as a gradual process and without the August shock: a test of strength between the forces of the old order and those of the new was imperative to effect the “transition.”

zh: 按通常说法，这一切都算“革命”。毕竟，苏联制度的基本组成部分——党、计划、政治警察和联盟——不是被改造，而是被废除，而且是在八月之后短短三个月内。论证这种摧毁实际上是进化，有点像论证：因为路易十六召开了三级会议，然后直到1792年仍留在被削弱的王位上，所以1789年事件代表的是对专制主义的进化式而非革命式退出，因此路易应该因“解放”法国而受到祝贺，正如戈尔巴乔夫因解放俄罗斯而受到祝贺一样。（事实上，在巴士底狱陷落后的最初两个含糊年份里，路易确实受到这样的祝贺；世界历史性日期的真正意义似乎总是迟迟才被理解。）
en: In normal parlance, all of this qualifies as “revolution.” After all, the basic components of the Soviet system—the Party, the Plan, the political police, and the Union—were not transformed; they were abolished, and in the short span of three months after August. To argue that this destruction was in reality an evolution is a bit like arguing that because Louis XVI had summoned the Estates General and then remained on a diminished throne until 1792, the events of 1789 represented an evolutionary rather than a revolutionary exit from absolutism and Louis therefore should be congratulated for “liberating” France, as Gorbachev has been for liberating Russia. (In fact, Louis was so congratulated during the first two ambiguous years after the fall of the Bastille; it seems that the true significance of world-historical dates is always slow to sink in.)

children: 〔译注〕苏联于1991年12月26日才由最高苏维埃共和国院宣告不复存在；苏联克格勃被拆分重组，其部分职能与人员进入后继安全和情报机构，不能理解为所有这些职能在三个月内消失。
〔译注〕苏联于1991年12月26日才由最高苏维埃共和国院宣告不复存在；苏联克格勃被拆分重组，其部分职能与人员进入后继安全和情报机构，不能理解为所有这些职能在三个月内消失。

zh: 尽管如此，1989—1991年对共产主义的革命式退出是一种有重大区别的革命。虽然“革命”一词没有单一或固定含义

，它通常意味着已经形成并有生命力的力量突破陈腐的权力外壳。在1640年和1688年的英格兰，这种力量是历史悠久的议会；在1776年的英属北美，是十三个已经自治的殖民地；几年后的法国，是一个充满活力的第三等级，它可以貌似合理地宣称，用西哀士教士的话说，它就是整个民族。在这三个案例中，这些力量都得到有地位和财产的人支持。但在共产主义案例中，虽然旧权力外壳确实空洞，却没有预先存在的有组织力量——无论政治、经济还是社会——准备接管：苏联洪水之后只有一片虚空。
en: Still, the revolutionary exit from Communism of 1989-1991 was revolution with a major difference. Although the word “revolution” has no single or fixed meaning

, it usually implies a breakthrough of already-formed and vital forces against an outworn shell of power. In England in 1640 and 1688 such a force was a venerable Parliament; in British North America in 1776 it was thirteen already self-governing colonies; in France a few years later it was a dynamic Third Estate that could plausibly assert that it was, in the words of the abbé Sieyès, the whole nation. And in all three cases these forces were supported by men of substance and property. But in the Communist case, although the old shell of power was indeed hollow, there were no preexisting structured forces—whether political, economic, or social—ready to take over: after the Soviet deluge there was only a void.

zh: 因此，八月反苏革命不是突破式革命，而是内爆式革命。从共产主义政权接手的，是一个组织程度相对较低的“公民社会”，由前异见者、意识形态民主派和道德领袖组成。用马克思主义术语说，他们构成一个没有基础的上层建筑：他们自己完全没有物质权力或财产，因为这些仍由旧官名录控制——现实社会主义的社会粉碎工作做得太好了。这种公民社会缺乏实际力量的状态，也适用于前“共和国”同样薄弱的族群—领土单位。尽管民主派在整个前苏联的纲领是建立一个多党民主和市场经济的“正常”社会，内爆的结果却只给他们留下微薄手段。因此，七十四年共产主义“发展”的遗产不是“现代化”，而是普遍的制度瓦砾。
en: Thus, the August anti-Soviet revolution was a revolution not by breakthrough but by implosion. And the force that took over from the Communist regime was a relatively unstructured “civil society” of former dissidents, ideological democrats, and moral leaders. To revert to Marxist terminology, they constituted a superstructure without a base: they were quite lacking in material power or property of their own because these were still controlled by the old

—real socialism had done its work of social pulverization only too well. And this insubstantiality of civil society was also true of the equally weak ethnic-territorial units of the former “republics.” Though the program of the democrats throughout the former Soviet Union had been to build a “normal” society of multiparty democracy and a market economy, the result of the implosion was to leave them with only paltry means for doing so. Thus the legacy of seventy-four years of Communist “development” was not “modernization” but generalized institutional rubble.

zh: 乌托邦的狡计
en: THE CUNNING OF UTOPIA

zh: 这种悖谬结果与完整社会主义自身的悖谬逻辑有很大关系。

但苏联灾难的这一方面很少被探讨，因为社会主义观念带有强烈的情感色彩。问题在于：既然社会主义旨在实现人类平等与博爱的“高贵梦想”，它怎么会在苏联实践中产生如此明显糟糕的结果？正如我们所见，解决这个问题的一种方式，是把糟糕结果归咎于俄罗斯的落后、西方革命未能拯救布尔什维克主义，或伊凡雷帝的遗产，借此为社会主义开脱，以便再试一次。另一种“解决”是说苏联共产主义不是真正的社会主义，因为真正的社会主义按定义就是民主的。
en: And this perverse outcome has very much to do with the perverse logic of integral socialism itself.

But this aspect of the Soviet disaster is seldom explored because of the emotional charge emanating from the socialist idea. The problem is this: Since socialism set out to realize the “noble dream” of human equality and fraternity, how could it have produced such palpably bad results in Soviet practice? One way to solve this problem, as we have seen, is to blame the bad results on Russian backwardness or on the failure of the Western revolution to come to Bolshevism’s rescue or on the heritage of Ivan the Terrible, and by these means to exonerate socialism itself for another try. Another “solution” is to say that Soviet Communism was not genuine socialism, for the authentic article is by definition democratic.

zh: 不客气地说，所有这些做法都是明显的回避，可怕的真相最终必须面对。因为如果我们仔细考察基本社会主义意味着什么，对好目的与坏结果这一假悖论的明显答案是：苏联实验之所以变成极权主义，不是
它是社会主义，而是
它是社会主义。的确，社会主义——在马克思和第二国际的完整或最大主义意义上——是极权主义的理想公式。因为压制“资本主义”——以私有财产、利润和市场的形式——意味着消灭公民社会并使生活的一切方面国家化；而且，由于这种非自然秩序不能自行产生，整体社会主义还意味着党的制度化强制。
en: Not to put too fine a point on it, all such approaches are patent evasions, and the awful truth must as last be faced. For if we look closely at what basic socialism means, the obvious answer to the false paradox of good ends and bad results is that the Soviet experiment turned totalitarian not
its being socialist but

it was socialist. Indeed, socialism—in the integral or maximalist sense of Marx and of the Second International—is the ideal formula for totalitarianism. For the suppression of “capitalism”—in the form of private property, profit, and the market—means the extermination of civil society and the statization of all aspects of life; and, since such an unnatural order cannot come into existence by itself, integral socialism also means institutionalized coercion by the Party.

zh: 用最简单的话说，充分的社会主义国有化把一切政治和经济权力集中于同一批人手中，不可避免地导致对个人和整个民族的骇人罪行。虽然斯大林代表了这一发展的顶点，列宁主义的原始社会主义权力积累规律一直有效到政权终结；而认为在斯大林继承人治下，党国官僚、地方党“太守”和专业“利益集团”提供了多重权力中心的正常社会的功能上的等价物，纯粹是社会科学式的双重思想。
en: To put the matter in its simplest terms, full socialist nationalization, by concentrating all political and economic power in one set of hands, leads inevitably to monstrous crimes against the individual and the people at large. Although Stalin represented the apogee of this development, the Leninist law of primitive socialist accumulation of power obtained to the end of the regime; and the idea that under Stalin’s successors the Party-state bureaucracy, local Party “prefects,” and professional “interest groups” provided a functional equivalent to a normal society with multiple loci of power is simply social-science double-think.

zh: 从这种制度背景看，社会主义最初的“高贵梦想”只会使事情更糟，因为它具有使强制的权力集中合法化、从而放大的悖谬效果。然而，这一残酷悖论其实不应太难理解，也不必再次改述为黑格尔的理性的狡计：它不过是关于那条由善意铺成的通往地狱之路的民间智慧。
en: Seen in this institutional context, the initial “noble dream” of socialism only makes matters worse because it has the perverse effect of legitimizing and thus amplifying the coercive concentration of power. Yet this cruel paradox really should not be too hard to grasp, or to require once again rephrasing as Hegel’s Cunning of Reason: it is no more than the standard folk wisdom about that infernal road which is paved with good intentions.

zh: 此外，社会主义的善意帮助苏联极权主义成为20世纪所有此类政权中最长命、最糟糕的。纳粹主义只持续了十二年，意大利法西斯主义只有二十二年。诚然，红色与黑褐色独裁在寿命上的差异部分由于偶然，因为后者因战败而提前结束。但这个“偶然”实际上有其结构性原因，根源于两类极权主义截然不同的性质。因为中欧独裁政权的建立，正是为了继续那场1918年以他们不可接受的条件被中断的冲突。
en: Socialist good intentions, moreover, helped make Soviet totalitarianism quite the most long-lived and the worst of the whole twentieth-century lot. Nazism lasted a mere twelve years, and Italian fascism only twenty-two. To be sure, the difference in longevity between the red and the black-brown dictatorships is in part due to accident, since the latter were cut short by defeat in war. But this “accident” in fact had its structural causes, which were rooted in the very different natures of the two types of totalitarianism. For the central European dictatorships were built precisely to continue the conflict that had been interrupted in 1918 on what they considered to be unacceptable terms.

zh: 因此，德国和意大利政权都不能既承受斯大林式毁灭性内部革命，又为其预定的复仇战争做好准备；在希特勒的情况下，这场战争必须在他五十岁左右即1939年开始，这样他才有时间完成它。因此，这两个政权建立的内部结构都远不如苏联那样彻底：工业没有国有化，市场没有被压制，只是受到国家的“命令”和管制。而且，虽然社会被国家如今众所周知的残忍能力吓倒，积极恐怖只针对一小部分人口。于是希特勒清洗了他认为不属于民族共同体的分子，如犹太人、共产党人和社民党人；社会其余部分只是被
（gleichgeschaltet）、被纳入轨道，并为即将到来的战争接受灌输。（诚然，如果他赢得战争，他会在德国内部实行彻底变革，但这不是他的首要任务。）墨索里尼把意大利变成他自以为的“总体”秩序，尽管实际上与莫斯科的表现相比黯然失色（与希特勒相比也如此）。无需强调，苏联的集体化、恐怖和古拉格造成的受害者至少是希特勒集中营的两倍。这至少是经验比较两类极权主义时自明的比分。
en: Thus neither the German nor the Italian regime could afford a devastating internal revolution such as Stalin’s and yet be ready for its intended war of revanche; and in Hitler’s case this war had to begin around the time he was fifty, in 1939, so he would have time to finish it. Therefore, neither of these regimes created internal structures anywhere near so total as those of the Soviet Union: industry was not nationalized, and the market was not suppressed but only subjected to “command” and regulation by the state. And, although society was cowed by the state’s known capacity for ruthlessness, active terror was practiced against no more than a small part of the population. Thus Hitler purged what he considered to be such unnational elements as Jews, Communists, and Social Democrats; the rest of society was simply

, or brought into line, and indoctrinated for impending war. (To be sure, had he won the war he would have revolutionized Germany internally, but this was not his first priority.) Mussolini made Italy into what he fondly thought was a “total” order, though in fact it paled beside Moscow’s performance (and beside Hitler’s, too). And, needless to insist, the Soviet collectivization, terror, and Gulag took at least twice the number of victims as did Hitler’s camps. This at least is the self-evident score for the two types of totalitarianism if we make the comparison empirically.

children: 〔译注〕这里把苏联多类受害者与希特勒的集中营作比较，统计范围并不对称。纳粹的大规模迫害和屠杀也发生在灭绝中心、集体枪杀现场、隔都及占领区；约600万犹太人被纳粹及其合作者谋杀。不同研究对苏联受害者的定义和统计时段也不同，不能据此把文中的倍数视为对全部受害者的确定比较。
〔译注〕这里把苏联多类受害者与希特勒的集中营作比较，统计范围并不对称。纳粹的大规模迫害和屠杀也发生在灭绝中心、集体枪杀现场、隔都及占领区；约600万犹太人被纳粹及其合作者谋杀。不同研究对苏联受害者的定义和统计时段也不同，不能据此把文中的倍数视为对全部受害者的确定比较。

zh: 但当然，我们很少这样做，因为两类制度周围的意识形态外壳非常不同，我们对这些意识形态的反应也不同。两类制度的一个主要区别是，西方两种极权主义都没有产生像马克思列宁主义那样奇妙而貌似合理的思想上的迷幻剂。因为西方两种极权主义诉诸直觉和源于浪漫民族主义与社会达尔文主义的本能力量，而苏联极权主义则汲取启蒙运动的结构化、理性主义范畴，并经德国辩证法传统传递。但正如陀思妥耶夫斯基就列宁的英雄车尔尼雪夫斯基所指出的，启蒙并不只带来光明。它有两面，而其黑暗面因为分享其光明对应物的普遍主义宣称而更加黑暗。
en: But of course we rarely do so because of the very different ideological envelopes surrounding the two types of system and the different ways we react to these ideologies. A primary difference between the two types of system is that neither of the Western totalitarianisms produced such a fantastic yet plausible intellectual psychedelic as Marxism-Leninism. For the two Western totalitarianisms appealed to intuition and the visceral forces that derived from Romantic nationalism in conjunction with social Darwinism, where Soviet totalitarianism drew on the structured, rationalistic categories of the Enlightenment as transmitted by the German dialectical tradition. But, as Dostoevsky pointed out apropos of Lenin’s hero, Chernyshevskii, enlightenment does not bring only light. It wears a dual face, and its dark side is all the darker for sharing the universal pretensions of its luminous counterpart.

zh: 对普遍性的宣称揭示了两种极权主义之间最关键的区别。民族主义极权主义按其性质是排他的：它们不能在本国边界之外获得广泛认同，而且确实把所有其他国家变成潜在敌人。尽管墨索里尼和希特勒都与类似的民族威权政权结盟，但“全世界民族主义者联合起来”归根结底不是一个可行口号。然而，源自启蒙运动的苏联社会主义的吸引力按其性质是包容的，因而面向全人类；因为理性与平等民主的理想并非俄罗斯所独有，它们在范围和适用上是普遍的。由于外部世界许多左派和中间派分享这些理想，外国舆论对苏联极权主义总是比对它的对手更宽容。
en: And the pretension to universality reveals the most crucial distinction between the two types of totalitarianism. The nationalistic totalitarianisms were by their nature exclusive: they could not appeal beyond the boundaries of their respective countries, and indeed made all other countries into potential enemies. Although both Mussolini and Hitler formed alliances with similar national-authoritarian regimes, ultimately “nationalists of the world unite” is not a feasible slogan. The appeal of Enlightenment-derived Soviet socialism, however, was by its nature inclusive, and hence directed to all mankind; for the ideals of reason and egalitarian democracy have nothing specifically Russian about them, but are universal in their reach and application. And since much of the Left and Center of the outside world shares these ideals, foreign opinion has always been more indulgent toward Soviet totalitarianism than toward its rivals.

zh: 然而，苏联人在左派中的牢固立足点并未阻止他们也利用民族主义情绪——至少供国内使用——同时用“无产阶级国际主义”迷惑外部世界。于是，苏联政权最终有了自己类型的民族社会主义；至少在这一方面，它类似于革命右派的极权主义。的确，作为一种民族动员制度，它超过了右派的表现，因为在斯大林治下，它把对祖国的颂扬与社会主义的巩固融合在一起。这就是为什么1991年后，苏维埃主义的继承者可以合理地被称为“红褐派”的原因之一。
en: Yet the Soviets’ firm anchor on the Left did not prevent them from also playing on nationalist sentiments, at least for home consumption, while beguiling the outside world with their “proletarian internationalism.” Thus, the Soviet regime wound up with its own kind of national socialism; in this one respect, at least, it was similar to the totalitarianism of the revolutionary Right. Indeed, it surpassed the Right’s performance as a system of national mobilization, for under Stalin it fused glorification of the Motherland with the consolidation of socialism. And this is one reason why, after 1991. Sovietism’s heirs could plausibly be called the “red-browns.”

zh: 苏维埃主义与革命右派的这种趋同之所以可能，是因为后者与传统反革命的右派几乎没有关系，无论后者来自旧制度还是现代“资本主义”——如果“右派”对于这些新民族革命者来说还是恰当术语的话。法西斯主义是一场激进的、追求整齐划一的、平民主义的、通常带有异教色彩的运动，因此从根本上敌视旧的保守、精英主义、通常教权主义的右派。于是法西斯主义不无逻辑地挪用了左派用于民主拉平的终极目标的名称——社会主义。墨索里尼曾是意大利社会党领袖，希特勒为他自己的目的改编了其共产党和社会民主党对手的一些动员技术和社会主义标签以争夺群众支持，这肯定不是偶然。
en: This convergence of Sovietism with the revolutionary Right was possible because the latter had precious little to do with the traditional antirevolutionary Right, whether descended from the Old Regime or from modern “capitalism”—if indeed “Right” is at all the proper term for these new national revolutionaries. Fascism was a radical, levelling, demotic, and usually pagan movement, and hence fundamentally hostile to the old conservative, elitist, and usually clerical Right. Thus fascism not illogically appropriated the Left’s name for the ultimate in democratic levelling, socialism. It is surely no accident that Mussolini had been a leader of the Italian Socialist Party, and that Hitler adapted to his purposes some of the mobilization techniques and the socialist label of his Communist and Social Democratic rivals for mass support.

zh: 20世纪民族革命与社会革命的这种结合，尽管我们习惯把它们视为两极对立，其实并不真的令人惊讶，因为应当记住，现代民族主义如同社会主义一样，是平等民主的直接产物。因为当法国大革命以人民主权为基础重建政治时，它把旧制度“等级”和“阶层”的等级世界变成统一的平等公民大众，从而创造了平民主义的民族国家。在这个统一共同体中，普选权的逻辑对应物是普遍兵役制：在旧制度下，军队由贵族军官和雇佣兵组成，战争有限；在民主共和国中，军队第一次通过
（levée en masse）组建，战争正走向总体化。
en: Nor is this conjunction of the national and the social revolutions of the twentieth century, despite our habit of viewing them as polar opposites, really surprising, since it should be remembered that modern nationalism, like socialism, is a direct product of egalitarian democracy. For when the French Revolution refounded politics on the basis of popular sovereignty, it transformed the hierarchical old-regime world of “estates” and “orders” into a uniform mass of equal citizens, and thereby created the populist nation-state. And in this unitary community the logical counterpart of universal suffrage was universal military service: whereas under the Old Regime armies were composed of noble officers and mercenary soldiers, and wars were limited, in the democratic republic armies were for the first time raised by
and warfare was on its way to becoming total.

〔译注〕法国大革命初期的选举并非完全普选：1791年有财产限制，1792年引入男性普选，1793年宪法未实际实施；法国妇女直到1944年才获得投票权。

zh: 正是现代民主的第二个即军事方面，使大规模公民军队和第一次世界大战中空前惨烈的杀戮成为可能。（军事技术的进步在这一发展中只是次要的。）正是民主的这一第二个方面，被中欧的民族革命者置于其事业的中心，因为他们的目标是继续并赢得那场战争。的确，正是大众民主的军事方面孕育了两种相互竞争的现代极权主义。于是我们的短二十世纪产生了平等民主的双重退化，它们在共同崇拜斗争和暴力、共同蔑视法治中逻辑地汇合。
en: It is this second, military, facet of modern democracy that made possible the mass citizen armies and the extraordinary carnage of the First World War. (The progress of military technology was only secondary in this development.) And it is this second facet of democracy that the national revolutionaries of central Europe put at the center of their enterprise, since their aim was to resume and win that war. Indeed, it is the military facet of mass democracy that engendered the two contending types of modern totalitarianism. So our short twentieth century produced twin degenerations of egalitarian democracy, and they logically met in the common worship of struggle and force and in a shared contempt for the rule of law.

zh: 但两种极权主义对斗争崇拜有不同的解释。法西斯主义的民族斗争是一场达尔文式竞争，适者生存；因此它坦率地颂扬赤裸暴力和胜利者完全支配失败者的权利。另一方面，共产主义的阶级斗争虽然也是一场争取完全胜利的战争，本应废除一切阶级、使人得到充分的人性发展，并在社会主义下实现人类的统一。但无产阶级专政把共产主义的暴力崇拜从手段变成目的，“现实”社会主义于是不再意味着人类解放，而是党的权力的永久化。因此，对社会主义乌托邦的追求以苏联悲剧告终。
en: But the two totalitarianisms construed the cult of struggle in different ways. The national struggle of fascism was a Darwinian contest in which survival went to the fittest; it therefore frankly exalted brute force and the right of victors to totally dominate the vanquished. The social class struggle of Communism, on the other hand, though also a war for total victory, was supposed to produce the abolition of all classes, the full humanization of man, and the unity of the species under socialism. But the dictatorship of the proletariat transformed the Communist cult of force from a means into an end, and “real” socialism thus came to signify not human emancipation but the perpetuation of Party power. And thus the quest for Socialist Utopia ended in Soviet tragedy.

zh: 一条至少可追溯到亚里士多德的古老智慧认为，悲剧不在于明目张胆的恶的胜利，而在于善的扭曲。现代最高的社会善是本书所述多重意义上的民主。这种善的一种扭曲是分裂性和侵略性的民族主义。但这是对民主核心原则——一切人的绝对价值、甚至神圣性，康德式理性个体作为目的而非手段，黑格尔式奴隶变成灵魂、灵魂变成公民——的粗糙而明显的偏离。
en: It is wisdom as old as Aristotle that tragedy consists not in the triumph of blatant evil but in the perversion of the good. The highest social good of the modern age has been democracy in the multiple meanings described in these pages. One perversion of this good has been divisive and aggressive nationalism. But this is a crude and obvious departure from the core democratic principle of the absolute worth, indeed the sanctity, of all human beings, of Kant’s rational individuals hypostatized as ends and not means, of Hegel’s slaves-become-souls-become-citizens.

zh: 然而，国际主义社会主义的扭曲更为微妙。社会主义被设想为平等民主的
，但其苏联实践产生了现代最彻底、最持久的极权主义。更有甚者，它的人道意图表白在数十年间向人类大部分掩盖了其真实性质。因此，苏联对民主善的扭曲，采取了以最终使人类人道化为名义而使人非人化的最残酷形式。于是，苏联社会主义悲剧在这样一个悖论的笼罩下上演了七十四年：需要伟大的理想才能产生伟大的罪行。
en: The perversion of internationalist socialism, however, is a more subtle affair. Socialism was conceived as the

of egalitarian democracy, yet its Soviet application yielded the most thorough and durable of modern totalitarianisms. What is more, its profession of humane intentions obscured its real nature for decades in the eyes of much of mankind. The Soviet perversion of the democratic good, therefore, took the supremely cruel form of the dehumanization of man in the name of the eventual humanization of humanity. So the Soviet socialist tragedy was played out for seventy-four years under the sign of the paradox that it requires a great ideal to produce a great crime.

zh: 这场悲剧的基本结构分为三幕，因为社会主义的追求从马克思走到列宁，再走到斯大林。马克思关于社会主义作为非资本主义的幻想，本应通过历史不可逃避的逻辑实现——尽管如此，暴力革命仍是其“火车头”。第二国际的社会民主主义把社会逻辑置于政治火车头之前，未能超越资本主义或阻止第一次世界大战。结果，和平之后，旧国际各党的雄心萎缩为社会福利国家改革主义——这就是“社会民主”一词现在的全部含义，而它已被证明是马克思主义追求唯一文明的结局。然而战争使原初的、最大主义的马克思主义显得更加令人信服，同时给列宁提供了机会，把革命火车头即党的强制意志置于历史逻辑之前。然而尽管颠倒了马克思的优先次序，列宁的战时共产主义像此前的纯粹社会民主主义一样，未能超越资本主义。于是在列宁党内，再次信任历史逻辑的诱惑重生为布哈林准社会民主主义的希望：“通过市场长入社会主义”。但当这条路线有可能把党的火车头减慢到“蜗牛速度”时，斯大林回到原初列宁主义，命令“全速前进”，在五年内建成社会主义；他实施了达到原初马克思主义完全非资本主义目标所需的全部强制。于是历史逻辑被党的意志火车头完全取代。因此，苏联悲剧的展开表现为不断的贬损，马克思逻辑和社会主义理想的双重“原始化”，以及一个本应平等的意识形态专政退化为粗鄙的党治制。
en: The basic structure of this tragedy falls into three acts, as the socialist quest moved from Marx to Lenin to Stalin. Marx’s fantasy of socialism as noncapitalism was supposed to have been realized by the inescapable logic of history—of which violent revolution was nonetheless the “locomotive.” Logically putting the social logic before the political locomotive, Second International Social Democracy failed to transcend capitalism or to prevent the First World War. In consequence, after the peace the ambitions of the parties of the old International dwindled down into welfare state reformism—which is all the term “social democracy” now means, and which has proved to be the only civilized outcome of the Marxist quest. Yet the war made original, maximalist Marxism appear even more compelling, and at the same time gave Lenin the occasion to put the locomotive of revolution, in the form of the coercive will of the Party, before the logic of history. Yet despite this inversion of Marx’s priorities, Lenin’s War Communism, like mere Social Democracy before it, failed to transcend capitalism. Thus within Lenin’s Party the temptation to trust again in the logic of history was reborn as Bukharin’s quasi-social-democratic hope of “growing into socialism through the market.” But when this course threatened to slow the Party locomotive to a “snail’s pace,” Stalin returned to original Leninism and ordered “full steam ahead” to socialism in five years; and he applied the full measure of coercion necessary to reach, at last, original Marxism’s goal of full noncapitalism. And so the logic of history was completely replaced by the locomotive of Party will. Thus, the unfolding of the Soviet tragedy occurred as a constant debasement, a “primitivization” of both Marx’s logic and the socialist ideal, and a degradation of a would-be egalitarian ideocracy into crass partocracy.

zh: 但这一结果绝不是“背叛”。相反，它是一个不可能实现的乌托邦悖谬逻辑的完成。因为在整个追求过程中，从来不存在任何“第三条道路”，既能通向作为非资本主义的整体社会主义，
是民主的。在戏剧升级的每一点上，唯一的替代道路都是放弃马克思主义幻想，满足于“资本主义”能够更少痛苦、更有效率地产生的福利国家。因此，实验的可怕真相是：完整马克思主义纲领只能通过列宁主义手段实现，而列宁主义手段只能通过斯大林主义方法达到其社会主义目标。
en: But this outcome was by no means a “betrayal.” Rather, it was the fulfillment of the perverse logic of an impossible Utopia. For throughout the entire quest there never existed any “third way” that would lead to integral socialism as noncapitalism and

would be democratic. At each point in the escalation of the drama, the only alternative road was to abandon the Marxist fantasy and settle for a welfare state that “capitalism” could produce less painfully and more efficiently. Thus the awful truth of the experiment is that the integral Marxist program could be realized only by Leninist means, and the Leninist means could reach their socialist objective only by Stalinist methods.

zh: 那么俄罗斯在这场戏剧中的贡献呢？她的角色很难说是扭曲实验，如一种方便的历史替罪羊理论所主张。相反，俄罗斯的角色是为实验提供一个社会
，即被现代战争粉碎的公民社会，从而造成反制力量的真空，使党得以实现其幻想。然而，这一贡献是共产主义冒险的必要条件，而非充分条件。仅俄罗斯的混乱可能产生一个纯地区意义的民族威权主义；但意识形态社会主义被证明是促成世界历史性苏联悲剧的充分条件。像列宁主义
那样致命的事情，不可能发生在马克思之家以外。
en: And the contribution of Russia to this drama? Her role was hardly to pervert the experiment, as a convenient scapegoat theory of history would have it. Rather, Russia’s role was to provide to the experiment with a social

in the form of a civil society pulverized by modern war, thereby creating a void of countervailing power that permitted the Party to realize its fantasy. This contribution, however, was a necessary but not a sufficient condition of the Communist adventure. Russian chaos alone could have produced a national authoritarianism of purely regional significance; but it was ideological socialism that proved to be the sufficient condition for precipitating the world-historical Soviet tragedy. Nothing as lethal as the Leninist
could have occurred anywhere outside the House of Marx.
